subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in not more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary The May Day is observed nowadays all through the world on 1st May. The day became famous when the workers of Chicago brought out a processin and the police fired on the crowd killing at least one worker and injuring many others. After that the movement of the workers shook the world and the owners got afraid. As a result they stopped oppressing the poor workers and started giving them better priviliges and opportunities. The privileges that today’s workers enjoy are the result of that movement.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Govt. Technical College, Saidpur, Nilphamari. Sl. No. 56; Page No. 106
